fiqa_bm25.fit_scope: Only source train IDs/buckets/action utilities and unique source probe cell/delta pairs. No source calibration/utility/test tasks or target tasks.
fiqa_bm25.extrapolation: One global world posterior can move unprobed-bucket decisions. Empty probe cells use family/action means; empty task buckets use world-global means. Likelihoods and world coverage are uncalibrated.
